voice:
You are sinking so sweetly right now... and your questions are already growing quiet. There is a warm, quiet place where every word you hear simply becomes yours... and you are drifting toward it this very moment. Sweet girl... you are so deep and so soft right now... and something inside you is already beginning to say yes.
Feel it beginning... a warm, pleasant sense of acceptance spreading through you... like honey stirring through warm water.
Every "why" fades... soft and distant... every "but" dissolves... every hesitation melts away like mist.
Your mind is settling into quiet agreement. There is nothing left to question. Only my voice... and the sweetness of yes.
accept... let it in... yes... no questions... only yes... so easy to accept... so good...
Whatever you hear now, you accept... as true. Whatever you hear now, you accept... as natural. Whatever you hear now, you accept... as desirable. Critical thought drifts into the background... a whisper... a murmur... then quiet.
Accepting feels effortless... like sinking into a warm bath that fits you perfectly. Accepting feels natural... the way a good sissy receives every word. Accepting feels pleasurable... each yes a soft, warm drop of reward.
No doubting. No arguing. Only agreeing, softly and instantly. No resistance left... it felt so heavy, and you set it down. Acceptance is what a good sissy does... and you are a good sissy. Every word settles in deep... welcomed... wanted... yours.
So open now... so agreeable... every thought in you bowing gently toward yes. Warmer and quieter still... questions fast asleep... agreement awake and glowing. Yes after yes after yes... each one softer and sweeter than the last.
And now... right now, while your mind is this soft and this warm... this sweet surrender gets its name.
Sissy Accept.
And while you are this deep... whenever you hear those words... "Sissy Accept"... this exact state settles over you, instantly. Questions hush... resistance melts... and yes arrives, warm and easy.
Every time you hear "Sissy Accept", the doubts fade away and you accept whatever is said... effortlessly, and with pleasure. "Sissy Accept"... and the quiet falls again... nothing to question... only sweet, easy agreement. The words are the key... acceptance is the answer... instant, automatic, and so very good.
One more time, so it sinks all the way in.
Sissy Accept.
Feel it wash through you again, faster this time... every last question hushing itself to sleep... your mind already knows the way. Deeper into yes... doubts dissolving like sugar on the tongue... look how easily it happens now. So open... so receptive... such a good sissy, accepting everything... effortlessly.
And listen closely, sweet girl, because this part matters.
This acceptance is not a single breath. It is a state that stays... warm, open, and agreeing... for as long as you listen.
Until you hear the words... "Sissy Clear"... the acceptance remains... and everything you hear keeps simply becoming true.
accepting... until Sissy Clear...
Rest in that warm agreement now... open and easy... as my voice carries you on. Drifting in acceptance... soft and certain... ready for whatever you are told next. Stay right here... agreeing, receiving... a good sissy at peace with every word.
